data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for accessing Android Lifecycle within other plugins.
data.what_it_does: Allows other Flutter plugins to access Android Lifecycle objects in the plugin's binding. Forces plugins to have a pub constraint signifying the major version of the Android Lifecycle API they expect.
use_when: You are developing a Flutter plugin that needs access to the Android Lifecycle API.
You want to use FlutterLifecycleAdapter within an Android plugin implementation.
avoid_when: You are building a standard Flutter application rather than a plugin.
You do not need to interact with native Android lifecycle components.
strengths: Enables safe access to Android Lifecycle objects for plugin developers.
Enforces pub constraints for major Android Lifecycle API versions.
data.setup_notes: Used as a dependency in other Android-specific Flutter plugins with a minimum Android SDK of 24.
